                cell(pat, b + 14, 3, "C-5", 10, 24 if style != "verse" else 18)
        if fill and bar == 3:
            cell(pat, b + 10, 11, "A-4", 14, 38)
            cell(pat, b + 13, 11, "F-4", 14, 42)
            cell(pat, b + 15, 11, "C-4", 14, 46)
            for h in range(8, 16):
                cell(pat, b + h, 2, "C-6", 9, 16 + (h - 8) * 2)

def bassline(pat, roots, style="pulse"):
    for bar, root in enumerate(roots):
        name, octs = root.split("-")
        octv = int(octs)
        b = bar * 16
        fifth = tr(name, 7)
        fourth = tr(name, 5)
        m3 = tr(name, 3)
        M2 = tr(name, 2)
        if style == "pulse":
            seq = [
                (0,  N(name, octv), 58),
                (3,  N(name, octv), 36),
                (6,  N(fifth, octv), 48),
                (8,  N(name, octv), 56),
                (11, N(m3, octv), 34),
                (12, N(name, octv + 1), 50),
                (14, N(fifth, octv), 40),
            ]
        elif style == "drive":
            seq = [
                (0,  N(name, octv), 60),
                (3,  N(fifth, octv), 42),
                (4,  N(name, octv), 54),
                (6,  N(name, octv + 1), 46),
                (8,  N(name, octv), 58),
                (10, N(fifth, octv), 40),
                (12, N(m3, octv + 1), 48),
                (14, N(name, octv), 38),
            ]
        elif style == "walk":
            seq = [
                (0,  N(name, octv), 56),
                (3,  N(M2, octv), 36),
                (6,  N(m3, octv), 46),
                (8,  N(fifth, octv), 52),
                (12, N(fourth, octv), 44),
                (14, N(name, octv + 1), 40),
            ]
        elif style == "sparse":
            seq = [
                (0,  N(name, octv), 52),
                (6,  N(fifth, octv), 40),
                (12, N(name, octv + 1), 44),
            ]
        else:
            seq = [(0, N(name, octv), 56)]
        for r, nt, vol in seq:
            cell(pat, b + r, 4, nt, 1, vol)
        # sub supports downbeats only — one octave under the bass note
        cell(pat, b, 5, N(name, octv - 1), 11, 38)
        if style in ("drive", "pulse"):
            cell(pat, b + 8, 5, N(name, octv - 1), 11, 30)

def pad(pat, chords, vol=28, octv=4, ch=7):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        root, third, fifth = tones
        cell(pat, b, ch, N(root, octv), 3, vol)
        cell(pat, b + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)          # slow vibrato
        cell(pat, b + 8, ch, N(fifth, octv), 3, vol + 2)
        cell(pat, b + 10, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)

def organ(pat, chords, ch=9, vol=26, octv=4, rhythm=(2, 6, 10, 14)):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        for i, h in enumerate(rhythm):
            # cycle root / third / fifth / root+oct so the stab outlines the chord
            tone = tones[i % 3]
            oc = octv + (1 if i == 3 else 0)
            cell(pat, b + h, ch, N(tone, oc), 6, vol if i % 2 == 0 else vol - 4)

def arp(pat, chords, ch=6, inst=5, vol=28, octb=5, shape="up", every=2):
    shapes = {
        "up": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[2], 1),
        ],
        "down": lambda t: [
            (t[2], 1), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0),
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 0),
        ],
        "bounce": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[2], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 1), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0),
        ],
        "hook": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 1),
        ],
    }

        for r, nt, vol in seq:
            cell(pat, b + r, 4, nt, 1, vol)
        # sub supports downbeats only — one octave under the bass note
        cell(pat, b, 5, N(name, octv - 1), 11, 38)

def pad(pat, chords, vol=28, octv=4, ch=7):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        root, third, fifth = tones
        cell(pat, b, ch, N(root, octv), 3, vol)
        cell(pat, b + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)          # slow vibrato
        cell(pat, b + 8, ch, N(fifth, octv), 3, vol + 2)
        cell(pat, b + 10, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)

def organ(pat, chords, ch=9, vol=26, octv=4, rhythm=(2, 6, 10, 14)):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        for i, h in enumerate(rhythm):
            # cycle root / third / fifth / root+oct so the stab outlines the chord
            tone = tones[i % 3]
            oc = octv + (1 if i == 3 else 0)
            cell(pat, b + h, ch, N(tone, oc), 6, vol if i % 2 == 0 else vol - 4)

def arp(pat, chords, ch=6, inst=5, vol=28, octb=5, shape="up", every=2):
    shapes = {
        "up": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[2], 1),
        ],
        "down": lambda t: [
            (t[2], 1), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0),
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 0),
        ],
        "bounce": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[2], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 1), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0),
        ],
        "hook": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 1),
        ],
    }
    fn = shapes[shape]
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        order = fn(tones)
        rows = list(range(0, 16, every))
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            nm, oc = order[i % len(order)]
            accent = 5 if r % 8 == 0 else (2 if r % 4 == 0 else 0)
            cell(pat, b + r, ch, N(nm, octb + oc), inst, vol + accent)

def melody(pat, notes, ch=8, inst=2, vib=True):
    for i, (row, nt, vol) in enumerate(notes):
        cell(pat, row, ch, nt, inst, vol)
        if not vib:
            continue
        nxt = notes[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(notes) else 64
        if nxt - row >= 4 and row + 2 < nxt and row + 2 <= 63:
            cell(pat, row + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x37)

def echo(pat, notes, ch=10, delay=3, drop=18, floor=15, inst=4, octave=0):
    used = set()
    for row, nt, vol in notes:
        r = row + delay
        if r > 62 or r in used:
            continue
        v = vol - drop
        if v < floor:
            continue
        ntx = shift_oct(nt, octave) if octave else nt
        cell(pat, r, ch, ntx, inst, v)
        used.add(r)

def doubles(pat, notes, ch=10, inst=2, every=8, drop=18, oct_shift=-1):
    for row, nt, vol in notes:
        if row % every == 0 and row < 62:
            cell(pat, row, ch, shift_oct(nt, oct_shift), inst, max(18, vol - drop))

import struct
data=open("/workspace/submission/tune.xm","rb").read()
hsize=struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 60)[0]
nch=struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 68)[0]
npat=struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 70)[0]
print("channels", nch, "patterns", npat)
off=60+hsize

def unpack_pattern(pdata, rows, nch):
    """XM packed pattern -> list of rows of cells (note, inst, vol, eff, param) note is 0 empty or 1-96"""
    i=0
    cells=[]
    for r in range(rows):
        row=[]
        for c in range(nch):
            if i>=len(pdata):
                row.append((0,0,0,0,0)); continue
            b=pdata[i]; i+=1
            if b & 0x80:
                note=inst=vol=eff=param=0
                if b & 1:
                    note=pdata[i]; i+=1
                if b & 2:
                    inst=pdata[i]; i+=1
                if b & 4:
                    vol=pdata[i]; i+=1
                if b & 8:
                    eff=pdata[i]; i+=1
                if b & 16:
                    param=pdata[i]; i+=1
            else:
                note=b
                inst, vol, eff, param = pdata[i:i+4]
                i+=4
            row.append((note, inst, vol, eff, param))
        cells.append(row)
    return cells

for pi in range(npat):
    ph=struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0]
    rows=struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off+5)[0]
    dsize=struct.unpack_from("<H", data, off+7)[0]
    pdata=data[off+ph:off+ph+dsize]
    cells=unpack_pattern(pdata, rows, nch)
    # count pan effects
    pans=0
    notes=0
    for r in cells:
        for note, inst, vol, eff, param in r:
            if note: notes+=1
            if eff==8: pans+=1
    print(f"pat {pi} rows {rows} bytes {dsize} notes {notes} panfx {pans}")
    # show row 0
    print("  row0", cells[0])
    off += ph+dsize
print("file ok, inst region starts", off)

"""

Tuned so a C-4 trigger plays middle C (fundamental = C4 at the stored rate),

import numpy as np

import wave

SR = 22050
C4 = 261.6255653006

out = Path("/tmp/samples")

def write(name, x, sr=SR):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m, -1, 1)
    # leave a little headroom in the sample itself; the tracker volumes do the rest
    pcm = (x * 30000).astype(np.int16)
    path = out / name
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(sr)
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    print(f"{name:16} {len(pcm):6d}  {len(pcm)/sr*1000:7.1f} ms")
    return len(pcm)

    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return n, cycles * SR / n

    y = np.empty_like(x, dtype=np.float64)

        a *= np.exp(-0.11 * (k - 1))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    return y

def make_sub():

    return y

{"command":"python3 << 'PY'
"""
Samples for Crystal Gate.
Tuned so a C-4 trigger plays middle C (fundamental = C4 at the stored rate),
except drums, which are absolute one-shots played at C-4.
Looping samples complete an integer number of cycles so the loop is click-free,
and some carry a slow amplitude / harmonic motion that also closes over the loop.
"""
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import wave

SR = 22050
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def write(name, x, sr=SR):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m, -1, 1)
    # leave a little headroom in the sample itself; the tracker volumes do the rest
    pcm = (x * 30000).astype(np.int16)
    path = out / name
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(sr)
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    print(f"{name:16} {len(pcm):6d}  {len(pcm)/sr*1000:7.1f} ms")
    return len(pcm)

def n_for(cycles, f0=C4):
    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return n, cycles * SR / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty_like(x, dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, v in enumerate(x):
        acc = a * acc + (1 - a) * float(v)
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---------- bass: warm pulse, static, 2 cycles ----------
def make_bass():
    cycles = 2
    n, f0 = n_for(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.38
    for k in range(1, 17):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        a *= np.exp(-0.11 * (k - 1))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    return y

write("bass.wav", make_bass())

# ---------- sub: sine + a little 2nd ----------
def make_sub():
    n, f0 = n_for(2)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.05 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t)
    return y

write("sub.wav", make_sub())

# ---------- pulse lead: narrow pulse, 8 cycles, slow PWM-ish harmonic tilt that loops ----------
def make_pulse():
    cycles = 8
    n, f0 = n_for(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    phase = np.arange(n) / n
    # duty breathes 0.18..0.30 over the whole loop and returns
    duty_lfo = 0.24 + 0.06 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * phase)
    # compute per-sample via additive with time-varying coeffs is expensive but n~675
    y = np.zeros(n)
    # approximate varying duty by crossfading two static pulses with a looped LFO
    def pulse(duty):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1, 20):
            a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
            a *= 0.90 ** max(0, k - 5)
            z += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + 0.07 * k)
        return z
    a = pulse(0.18)
    b = pulse(0.32)
    mix = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * phase)  # 0..1..0
    y = a * (1 - mix) + b * mix
    # tiny level motion
    y *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * phase + 0.4)
    return y

write("pulse.wav", make_pulse())

# ---------- saw lead: bandlimited, looped harmonic bloom ----------
def make_saw():
    cycles = 8
    n, f0 = n_for(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    phase = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 14):
        y += (1.0 / k) * (0.90 ** (k - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * phase)  # 0-1-0
    y2 = np.zeros(n)
    for k in (2, 3, 5, 7):
        y2 += (0.18 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + 0.3 * k)
    y = y + y2 * bloom
    return y

write("saw.wav", make_saw())

# ---------- pad: ~0.9s, slow spectral drift, integer cycles ----------
def make_pad():
    cycles = 240
    n, f0 = n_for(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    lfo_a = 0.62 + 0.38 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    lfo_b = 0.50 + 0.50 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * ph + 0.8)
    lfo_c = 0.70 + 0.30 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3 * ph + 1.7)
    y = np.zeros(n)
    spec = [
        (1, 0.50, lfo_a, 0.0),
        (2, 0.28, lfo_b, 0.5),
        (3, 0.20, lfo_c, 1.2),
        (4, 0.11, lfo_a, 0.3),
        (5, 0.07, lfo_b, 1.9),
        (6, 0.045, lfo_c, 0.7),
        (8, 0.025, lfo_a, 1.4),
    ]
    for k, amp, lfo, p0 in spec:
        y += amp * lfo * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

write("pad.wav", make_pad())

# ---------- organ ----------
def make_organ():
    n, f0 = n_for(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, a, p0 in ((1, 0.50, 0.0), (2, 0.34, 0.2), (3, 0.26, 0.55),
                     (4, 0.12, 0.9), (6, 0.05, 1.3)):
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

write("organ.wav", make_organ())

# ---------- pluck ----------
def make_pluck(dur=0.46, bright=0.68, noise=0.28):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 22):
        decay = 0.07 + 0.36 / (k ** 0.5)
        amp = (bright ** (k - 1)) / (k ** 0.3)
        y += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * np.exp(-t / decay)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.72)
    y += noise * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.012)
    y[:16] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 16)
    y[-100:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 100)
    return y

write("pluck.wav", make_pluck(0.50, 0.66, 0.30))
write("arp.wav", make_pluck(0.26, 0.82, 0.18))

# ---------- bell ----------
def make_bell():
    n = int(0.85 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 1.98 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.20)
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * t + 2.8 * mod) * np.exp(-t / 0.42)
    y += 0.32 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.76 * t + 0.4) * np.exp(-t / 0.25)
    y += 0.14 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 5.04 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.12)
    y[:12] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 12)
    y[-300:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 300)
    return y

write("bell.wav", make_bell())

# ---------- kick: short, punchy, body ~48 Hz ----------
def make_kick():
    n = int(0.22 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = 46 + 170 * np.exp(-t / 0.022)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    body = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.10)
    click = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1400 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.0035)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.5)
    nz *= np.exp(-t / 0.005)
    y = body + 0.40 * click + 0.16 * nz
    y = np.tanh(y * 1.35)
    y[-40:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 40)
    return y

write("kick.wav", make_kick())

# ---------- snare ----------
def make_snare():
    n = int(0.15 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    low = lp1(nz, 0.62)
    high = nz - lp1(nz, 0.28)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 188 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.04)
    tone2 = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 342 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.028)
    y = 0.50 * high * np.exp(-t / 0.05) + 0.30 * low * np.exp(-t / 0.07)
    y += 0.42 * tone + 0.16 * tone2
    y = np.tanh(1.2 * y)
    y[:5] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 5)
    return y

write("snare.wav", make_snare())

# ---------- hats: metallic cluster, short ----------
def make_hat(dur, decay):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [313, 471, 583, 807, 1031, 1490, 2080, 2740, 3520, 4210]
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
        y += (0.5 / (1 + 0.32 * i)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6))
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.18)
    y = 0.5 * y + 0.55 * nz
    y *= np.exp(-t / decay)
    y[:3] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 3)
    return y

write("hat.wav", make_hat(0.032, 0.010))
write("ohat.wav", make_hat(0.095, 0.034))

# ---------- tom ----------
def make_tom(f0=118):
    n = int(0.20 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = f0 * 0.72 + (f0 * 0.7) * np.exp(-t / 0.045)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    y = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    y += 0.18 * np.sin(2 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.035)
    return y

write("tom.wav", make_tom(130))
write("tomlo.wav", make_tom(86))

# ---------- stab ----------
def make_stab():
    n = int(0.22 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 12):
        y += (1.0 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t) * np.exp(-t / (0.045 + 0.08 / k))
    y[:8] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 8)
    return y

write("stab.wav", make_stab())
print("samples ready")

{"command":"python3 << 'PY'
"""
Crystal Gate samples, tuned for this FT2 linear-frequency build.

Measured: a waveform authored at 8363 Hz, triggered at C-4, sounds one octave low.
So the playback rate at C-4 is 8363/2 = 4181.5 Hz. Samples whose C-4 should be
middle C are authored at SR_AUTH = 4181.5 with fundamental C4. Drums are authored
at the same rate with absolute pitches (played at C-4).
"""
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import wave

# Authoring rate = C-4 playback rate in this player.
SR = 4181.5
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def write(name, x, sr=int(round(SR))):
    # We set the WAV rate to an integer; the loader ignores rate, but length matters.
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * 0.92, -1, 1)
    pcm = (x * 32767).astype(np.int16)
    # avoid a nonzero first sample mismatch on tiny loops: fade not needed if periodic
    path = out / name
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(sr)
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    print(f"{name:18} {len(pcm):6d}")
    return len(pcm)

def n_cycles(cycles, f0=C4, sr=SR):
    n = int(round(cycles * sr / f0))
    n = max(8, n)
    return n, cycles * sr / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty_like(x, dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    for i, v in enumerate(x):
        acc = a * acc + (1 - a) * v
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---------- bass: warm 38% pulse, 4 cycles, mild looped brightness ----------
def make_bass():
    cycles = 4
    n, f0 = n_cycles(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.36
    for k in range(1, 14):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        a *= np.exp(-0.14 * (k - 1))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    # a little extra body
    y += 0.08 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y += bloom * 0.06 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * 3 * t)

    y *= 0.93 + 0.07 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * ph)
    return y

lp_ = write("pulse.wav", make_pulse())

# ---------- saw ----------
def make_saw():
    cycles = 8
    n, f0 = n_cycles(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 12):
        y += (1.0 / k) * (0.88 ** (k - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y2 = np.zeros(n)
    for k in (2, 3, 4, 6):
        y2 += (0.16 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + 0.4 * k)
    return y + y2 * bloom

lw = write("saw.wav", make_saw())

# ---------- pad ~1.1 s ----------
def make_pad():
    cycles = 288  # ~1.10 s
    n, f0 = n_cycles(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    la = 0.60 + 0.40 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    lb = 0.48 + 0.52 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * ph + 0.7)
    lc = 0.72 + 0.28 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3 * ph + 1.8)
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, amp, lfo, p0 in (
        (1, 0.48, la, 0.0),
        (2, 0.30, lb, 0.4),
        (3, 0.20, lc, 1.1),
        (4, 0.11, la, 0.2),
        (5, 0.07, lb, 1.7),
        (6, 0.04, lc, 0.6),
        (7, 0.025, la, 2.1),
    ):
        y += amp * lfo * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

lpad = write("pad.wav", make_pad())

# ---------- organ ----------
def make_organ():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, a, p0 in ((1, 0.48, 0), (2, 0.34, 0.25), (3, 0.26, 0.6),
                     (4, 0.11, 1.0), (6, 0.05, 1.4)):
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

lo = write("organ.wav", make_organ())

# ---------- plucks / bell (absolute-ish but harmonic at C4 so notes track) ----------
def make_pluck(dur=0.42, bright=0.70, noise_amt=0.25):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 16):
        decay = 0.06 + 0.30 / (k ** 0.45)
        amp = (bright ** (k - 1)) / (k ** 0.25)
        y += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t + rng.uniform(0, 6.2)) * np.exp(-t / decay)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.65)
    y += noise_amt * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.010)
    ramp = min(8, n // 8)
    y[:ramp] *= np.linspace(0, 1, ramp)
    y[-30:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 30)
    return y

lpl = write("pluck.wav", make_pluck(0.48, 0.64, 0.28))
lar = write("arp.wav", make_pluck(0.22, 0.80, 0.16))

def make_bell():
    n = int(0.70 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 1.99 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.16)
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * t + 2.4 * mod) * np.exp(-t / 0.36)
    y += 0.30 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.76 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.20)
    y += 0.12 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 5.1 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.10)
    y[:6] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 6)
    y[-40:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 40)
    return y

lbll = write("bell.wav", make_bell())

# ---------- drums at absolute pitch (played on C-4) ----------
def make_kick():
    n = int(0.20 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = 52 + 160 * np.exp(-t / 0.020)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    body = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    click = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1800 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.003)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.45)
    y = body + 0.35 * click + 0.14 * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.004)
    y = np.tanh(y * 1.3)
    y[-12:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 12)
    return y

lk = write("kick.wav", make_kick())

def make_snare():
    n = int(0.14 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    low = lp1(nz, 0.55)
    high = nz - lp1(nz, 0.22)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 190 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.035)
    tone2 = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 330 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.022)
    y = 0.48 * high * np.exp(-t / 0.045) + 0.28 * low * np.exp(-t / 0.06)
    y += 0.40 * tone + 0.15 * tone2
    y = np.tanh(1.15 * y)
    y[:3] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 3)
    return y

lsn = write("snare.wav", make_snare())

def make_hat(dur, decay):
    n = max(8, int(dur * SR))
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [340, 490, 610, 830, 1080, 1540, 2140, 2890]
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
        y += (0.48 / (1 + 0.3 * i)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6))
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.15)
    y = 0.48 * y + 0.58 * nz
    y *= np.exp(-t / decay)
    y[:2] *= [0.3, 0.7]
    return y

lh = write("hat.wav", make_hat(0.030, 0.009))
loh = write("ohat.wav", make_hat(0.090, 0.030))

def make_tom(fstart=140):
    n = int(0.18 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = fstart * 0.65 + fstart * 0.8 * np.exp(-t / 0.04)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    y = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.08)
    y += 0.16 * np.sin(2 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    return y

lt = write("tom.wav", make_tom(150))

def make_stab():
    n = int(0.20 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 10):
        y += (1.0 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t) * np.exp(-t / (0.04 + 0.07 / k))
    y[:4] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 4)
    return y

lst = write("stab.wav", make_stab())

# save lengths for the composer

    "bass": lb, "sub": ls, "pulse": lp_, "saw": lw, "pad": lpad, "organ": lo,
    "pluck": lpl, "arp": lar, "bell": lbll, "kick": lk, "snare": lsn,
    "hat": lh, "ohat": loh, "tom": lt, "stab": lst,
}
import json
json.dump(lens, open("/tmp/samples/lengths.json", "w"))
print(lens)
PY"}

{"command":"python3 << 'PY'
"""
8-bit samples for the FT2 bridge (16-bit WAVs are misread as 8-bit).

Authoring rate: 8363 Hz. Measured: C-4 plays the sample at its authored rate.
Looping tones are integer cycles of C4 so a C-4 trigger is middle C.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import wave

SR = 8363.0
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(19)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def write(name, x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * 0.90, -1, 1)
    # remove DC so loops don't click and 8-bit stays centered
    x = x - np.mean(x)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * 0.90, -1, 1)
    pcm = np.clip(np.round((x + 1.0) * 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    path = out / f"{name}.wav"
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(1)
        w.setframerate(int(SR))
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    return len(pcm)

def n_cycles(cycles, f0=C4):
    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return max(8, n), cycles * SR / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty(len(x), dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, v in enumerate(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)):
        acc = a * acc + (1.0 - a) * v
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---- bass: warm pulse, 4 cycles, slight looped harmonic motion ----
def make_bass():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.35
    for k in range(1, 11):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        a *= np.exp(-0.16 * (k - 1))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y += 0.07 * bloom * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * 2 * t)
    return y

# ---- sub ----
def make_sub():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(2)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    return np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.04 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t)

# ---- pulse lead, PWM that closes over the loop ----
def make_pulse():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    def pulse(duty):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1, 13):

"""
8-bit samples for the FT2 bridge (16-bit WAVs are misread as 8-bit).

Authoring rate: 8363 Hz. Measured: C-4 plays the sample at its authored rate.
Looping tones are integer cycles of C4 so a C-4 trigger is middle C.

import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import wave

SR = 8363.0
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(19)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def write(name, x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * 0.90, -1, 1)
    # remove DC so loops don't click and 8-bit stays centered
    x = x - np.mean(x)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * 0.90, -1, 1)
    pcm = np.clip(np.round((x + 1.0) * 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    path = out / f"{name}.wav"
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(1)
        w.setframerate(int(SR))
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    return len(pcm)

def n_cycles(cycles, f0=C4):
    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return max(8, n), cycles * SR / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty(len(x), dtype=np.float64)
    acc = 0.0
    for i, v in enumerate(np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)):
        acc = a * acc + (1.0 - a) * v
        y[i] = acc
    return y

# ---- bass: warm pulse, 4 cycles, slight looped harmonic motion ----
def make_bass():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.35
    for k in range(1, 11):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        a *= np.exp(-0.16 * (k - 1))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y += 0.07 * bloom * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * 2 * t)
    return y

# ---- sub ----
def make_sub():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(2)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    return np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.04 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t)

# ---- pulse lead, PWM that closes over the loop ----
def make_pulse():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    def pulse(duty):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1, 13):
            a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
            a *= 0.86 ** max(0, k - 3)
            z += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + 0.04 * k)
        return z
    mix = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y = pulse(0.15) * (1 - mix) + pulse(0.32) * mix
    y *= 0.94 + 0.06 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph)
    return y

# ---- saw ----
def make_saw():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 10):
        y += (1.0 / k) * (0.86 ** (k - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y2 = 0.12 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.08 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * f0 * t)
    return y + bloom * y2

# ---- pad, ~1.15 s, spectral drift that returns ----
def make_pad():
    cycles = 300
    n, f0 = n_cycles(cycles)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    la = 0.58 + 0.42 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    lb = 0.45 + 0.55 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph + 0.6)
    lc = 0.70 + 0.30 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * ph + 1.5)
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, amp, lfo, p0 in (
        (1, 0.46, la, 0.0),
        (2, 0.32, lb, 0.35),
        (3, 0.20, lc, 1.0),
        (4, 0.12, la, 0.2),
        (5, 0.07, lb, 1.6),
        (6, 0.04, lc, 0.5),
    ):
        y += amp * lfo * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

# ---- organ ----
def make_organ():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, a, p0 in ((1, 0.46, 0.0), (2, 0.34, 0.3), (3, 0.24, 0.7),
                     (4, 0.12, 1.1), (6, 0.05, 1.5)):
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

# ---- pluck / arp (harmonic, so they track notes) ----
def make_pluck(dur, bright, noise_amt):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 12):
        decay = 0.05 + 0.26 / (k ** 0.45)
        amp = (bright ** (k - 1)) / (k ** 0.22)
        y += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * np.exp(-t / decay)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.55)
    y += noise_amt * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.008)
    y[:4] *= np.linspace(0, 1, 4)
    y[-8:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 8)
    return y

# ---- bell ----
def make_bell():
    n = int(0.62 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.0 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.14)
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * t + 2.2 * mod) * np.exp(-t / 0.32)
    y += 0.28 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.78 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.18)
    y += 0.10 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 5.2 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.08)
    y[:3] *= np.linspace(0.2, 1, 3)
    y[-16:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 16)
    return y

# ---- drums, absolute pitch, triggered at C-4 ----
def make_kick():
    n = int(0.18 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = 55 + 180 * np.exp(-t / 0.018)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    body = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.075)
    click = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1500 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.003)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    y = body + 0.32 * click + 0.12 * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.004)
    y = np.tanh(y * 1.25)
    y[-6:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 6)
    return y

def make_snare():
    n = int(0.13 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    low = lp1(nz, 0.50)
    high = nz - lp1(nz, 0.18)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 196 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.030)
    tone2 = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 340 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.018)
    y = 0.50 * high * np.exp(-t / 0.040) + 0.26 * low * np.exp(-t / 0.055)
    y += 0.38 * tone + 0.14 * tone2
    y = np.tanh(1.1 * y)
    return y

def make_hat(dur, decay):
    n = max(12, int(dur * SR))
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    freqs = [320, 510, 690, 910, 1280, 1760, 2340, 3100]
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
        y += (0.45 / (1 + 0.28 * i)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 6))

    y = 0.42 * y + 0.62 * nz
    y *= np.exp(-t / decay)

    n = int(0.16 * SR)

    f = fstart * 0.62 + fstart * 0.7 * np.exp(-t / 0.035)

    y = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.07)
    y += 0.14 * np.sin(2 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.025)

    n = int(0.18 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 8):
        y += (1.0 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t) * np.exp(-t / (0.035 + 0.06 / k))

lengths["sub"] = write("sub", make_sub())
lengths["pulse"] = write("pulse", make_pulse())
lengths["saw"] = write("saw", make_saw())
lengths["pad"] = write("pad", make_pad())
lengths["organ"] = write("organ", make_organ())
lengths["pluck"] = write("pluck", make_pluck(0.42, 0.62, 0.30))
lengths["arp"] = write("arp", make_pluck(0.20, 0.78, 0.16))
lengths["bell"] = write("bell", make_bell())
lengths["kick"] = write("kick", make_kick())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Crystal Gate — keygen module.

A minor, 146 BPM, speed 6, eight 64-row patterns, restart at order 0.

from pathlib import Path

SEMI = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(NOTES)}

def N(name, octv):
    return f"{name}-{int(octv)}"

def tr(name, semis):
    return NOTES[(SEMI[name] + semis) % 12]

def shift_oct(nt, d):
    name, oc = nt.split("-")
    return f"{name}-{int(oc) + d}"

batch = []

def add(tool, **kw):
    batch.append({"name": tool, "arguments": kw})

# works, but a follow-up effect-only write merges, which we still use so a
# loop restart re-asserts pan even if sample pan were ignored.
PANS = {
    0: 128,   # kick
    1: 156,   # snare
    2: 230,   # hat
    3: 24,    # open hat
    4: 88,    # bass
    5: 128,   # sub
    6: 214,   # arp
    7: 40,    # pad
    8: 150,   # lead
    9: 70,    # organ
    10: 20,   # echo
    11: 236,  # bells
}

    if not (0 <= row <= 63):
        return
    args = {"pattern": int(pat), "row": int(row), "channel": int(ch)}
    if note is not None:
        args["note"] = note
    if inst is not None:
        args["instrument"] = int(inst)
    if vol is not None:
        args["volume"] = int(max(1, min(64, round(vol))))
    if eff is not None:
        args["effect"] = int(eff)
        args["effect_param"] = int(param or 0)
    add("pattern_set_cell", **args)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
add("module_new", channels=12, name="Crystal Gate")

# instrument, file, name, loop?, default volume, sample pan
INST = [
    (1,  "bass",   "Bass",   True,  64, 88),
    (2,  "pulse",  "Pulse",  True,  56, 168),
    (3,  "pad",    "Pad",    True,  50, 40),
    (4,  "pluck",  "Pluck",  False, 54, 28),
    (5,  "arp",    "Arp",    False, 50, 220),
    (6,  "organ",  "Organ",  True,  48, 72),
    (7,  "kick",   "Kick",   False, 64, 128),
    (8,  "snare",  "Snare",  False, 52, 156),
    (9,  "hat",    "Hat",    False, 44, 232),
    (10, "ohat",   "OHat",   False, 42, 24),
    (11, "sub",    "Sub",    True,  56, 128),
    (12, "stab",   "Stab",   False, 46, 180),
    (13, "saw",    "Saw",    True,  56, 140),
    (14, "tom",    "Tom",    False, 50, 96),
    (15, "bell",   "Bell",   False, 44, 210),
]

    add("sample_load", path=path, instrument=inst, sample=0)
    add("instrument_set", instrument=inst, name=nm)

    """Write a cell, and on the first event of each (pattern, channel) also

    key = (pat, ch)

        pan_done.add(key)

G = ["G", "B", "D"]
Dm = ["D", "F", "A"]

    shapes = {
        "up": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[2], 1),
        ],
        "down": lambda t: [
            (t[2], 1), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0),
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 0),
        ],
        "bounce": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[2], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 1), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0),
        ],
        "hook": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 1),
        ],
    }
    fn = shapes[shape]
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        order = fn(tones)
        rows = list(range(0, 16, every))
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            nm, oc = order[i % len(order)]
            accent = 4 if r % 8 == 0 else (1 if r % 4 == 0 else 0)
            C(pat, b + r, ch, N(nm, octb + oc), inst, vol + accent)

        if fill and bar == 3:

    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):

        root, third, fifth = tones

        C(pat, b + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)

        C(pat, b + 10, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)

def organ(pat, chords, ch=9, vol=24, octv=4, rhythm=(2, 6, 10, 14)):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        for i, h in enumerate(rhythm):
            tone = tones[i % 3]
            oc = octv + (1 if i == 3 else 0)
            C(pat, b + h, ch, N(tone, oc), 6, vol if i % 2 == 0 else vol - 4)

def arp(pat, chords, ch=6, inst=5, vol=26, octb=5, shape="up", every=2):
    shapes = {
        "up": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[2], 1),
        ],
        "down": lambda t: [
            (t[2], 1), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0),
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 0),
        ],
        "bounce": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[2], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 1), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0),
        ],
        "hook": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 1),
        ],
    }
    fn = shapes[shape]
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        order = fn(tones)
        rows = list(range(0, 16, every))
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            nm, oc = order[i % len(order)]
            accent = 4 if r % 8 == 0 else (1 if r % 4 == 0 else 0)
            C(pat, b + r, ch, N(nm, octb + oc), inst, vol + accent)

def melody(pat, notes, ch=8, inst=2, vib=True):
    for i, (row, nt, vol) in enumerate(notes):
        C(pat, row, ch, nt, inst, vol)
        if not vib:
            continue
        nxt = notes[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(notes) else 64
        if nxt - row >= 4 and row + 2 < nxt and row + 2 <= 63:
            C(pat, row + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x37)

    used = set()
    for row, nt, vol in notes:

        if r > 62 or r in used:
            continue
        v = vol - drop
        if v >= floor:
            C(pat, r, ch, nt, inst, v)
            used.add(r)

    for row, nt, vol in notes:

A minor, 146 BPM, speed 6, eight 64-row patterns, restart at order 0.
The last pattern cadences on E so the loop resolves into the Am hook.
"""
import json
import wave
from pathlib import Path

NOTES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"]
SEMI = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(NOTES)}

def N(name, octv):
    return f"{name}-{int(octv)}"

def tr(name, semis):
    return NOTES[(SEMI[name] + semis) % 12]

def shift_oct(nt, d):
    name, oc = nt.split("-")
    return f"{name}-{int(oc) + d}"

batch = []

def add(tool, **kw):
    batch.append({"name": tool, "arguments": kw})

# Sample pan is the reliable stereo control in this build. Effect 8xx also
# works, but a follow-up effect-only write merges, which we still use so a
# loop restart re-asserts pan even if sample pan were ignored.
PANS = {
    0: 128,   # kick
    1: 156,   # snare
    2: 230,   # hat
    3: 24,    # open hat
    4: 88,    # bass
    5: 128,   # sub
    6: 214,   # arp
    7: 40,    # pad
    8: 150,   # lead
    9: 70,    # organ
    10: 20,   # echo
    11: 236,  # bells
}

def cell(pat, row, ch, note=None, inst=None, vol=None, eff=None, param=None):
    if not (0 <= row <= 63):
        return
    args = {"pattern": int(pat), "row": int(row), "channel": int(ch)}
    if note is not None:
        args["note"] = note
    if inst is not None:
        args["instrument"] = int(inst)
    if vol is not None:
        args["volume"] = int(max(1, min(64, round(vol))))
    if eff is not None:
        args["effect"] = int(eff)
        args["effect_param"] = int(param or 0)
    add("pattern_set_cell", **args)

for p in range(8):

    # re-assert channel pan on row 0 of an unused moment? We'll stamp effect 8
    # on the first note per channel inside helpers via a set.

pan_done = set()

def C(pat, row, ch, note=None, inst=None, vol=None, eff=None, param=None):
    """Write a cell, and on the first event of each (pattern, channel) also
    merge an 8xx pan so a pattern restart cannot drift."""
    cell(pat, row, ch, note, inst, vol, eff, param)
    key = (pat, ch)
    if key not in pan_done and eff is None:
        pan_done.add(key)
        add("pattern_set_cell", **{
            "pattern": int(pat), "row": int(row), "channel": int(ch),
            "effect": 8, "effect_param": int(PANS[ch]),
        })
    elif key not in pan_done:
        pan_done.add(key)

def drums(pat, style="verse", fill=False):
    for bar in range(4):
        b = bar * 16
        if style == "verse":
            kicks = [0, 8, 11]
            if bar % 2 == 1:
                kicks.append(14)
        elif style == "chorus":
            kicks = [0, 4, 8, 11, 12]
            if bar % 2 == 1:
                kicks.append(14)
        elif style == "drive":
            kicks = [0, 3, 4, 8, 11, 12]
            if not (fill and bar == 3):
                kicks.append(14)
        elif style == "push":
            kicks = [0, 3, 6, 8, 11, 14]
        elif style == "break":
            kicks = [0] + ([10] if bar >= 2 else [])
        else:
            kicks = [0, 8]
        for k in kicks:
            vol = 64 if k % 8 == 0 else (52 if k % 4 == 0 else 42)
            C(pat, b + k, 0, "C-4", 7, vol)

        if style == "break":
            snares = [12] if bar >= 1 else []
        else:
            snares = [4, 12]
            if style in ("chorus", "drive", "push") and bar % 2 == 0:
                snares.append(7)
        if fill and bar == 3:
            snares = [4, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]
        for s in snares:
            vol = 50 if s in (4, 12) else (30 if s >= 13 else 22)
            nt = "C-4" if s in (4, 12) else "D-4"
            C(pat, b + s, 1, nt, 8, vol)

        if style == "break":
            C(pat, b + 4, 2, "G-5", 9, 16)
            C(pat, b + 12, 2, "G-5", 9, 14)
            C(pat, b + 6, 3, "A-4", 10, 28)
            C(pat, b + 14, 3, "A-4", 10, 20)
        else:
            for h in range(0, 16, 2):
                vol = 12 if h % 4 == 0 else (30 if style in ("chorus", "drive") else 24)
                if h in (4, 12):
                    vol = 10
                C(pat, b + h, 2, "F#-5", 9, vol)
            if style in ("chorus", "drive"):
                C(pat, b + 1, 2, "A-5", 9, 12)
                C(pat, b + 9, 2, "A-5", 9, 12)
            if not (fill and bar == 3):
                C(pat, b + 6, 3, "C-5", 10, 26 if style != "verse" else 20)
                C(pat, b + 14, 3, "C-5", 10, 22 if style != "verse" else 16)
        if fill and bar == 3:
            C(pat, b + 10, 11, "A-4", 14, 36)
            C(pat, b + 13, 11, "F-4", 14, 40)
            C(pat, b + 15, 11, "C-4", 14, 44)
            for h in range(8, 16):
                C(pat, b + h, 2, "C-6", 9, 14 + (h - 8) * 2)

def bassline(pat, roots, style="pulse"):
    for bar, root in enumerate(roots):
        name, octs = root.split("-")
        octv = int(octs)
        b = bar * 16
        fifth = tr(name, 7)
        fourth = tr(name, 5)
        m3 = tr(name, 3)
        M2 = tr(name, 2)
        if style == "pulse":
            seq = [
                (0, N(name, octv), 58),
                (3, N(name, octv), 34),
                (6, N(fifth, octv), 46),
                (8, N(name, octv), 54),
                (11, N(m3, octv), 32),
                (12, N(name, octv + 1), 48),
                (14, N(fifth, octv), 38),
            ]
        elif style == "drive":
            seq = [
                (0, N(name, octv), 60),
                (3, N(fifth, octv), 40),
                (4, N(name, octv), 52),
                (6, N(name, octv + 1), 44),
                (8, N(name, octv), 56),
                (10, N(fifth, octv), 38),
                (12, N(m3, octv + 1), 46),
                (14, N(name, octv), 36),
            ]
        elif style == "walk":
            seq = [
                (0, N(name, octv), 56),
                (3, N(M2, octv), 34),
                (6, N(m3, octv), 44),
                (8, N(fifth, octv), 50),
                (12, N(fourth, octv), 42),
                (14, N(name, octv + 1), 38),
            ]
        else:  # sparse
            seq = [
                (0, N(name, octv), 52),
                (6, N(fifth, octv), 38),
                (12, N(name, octv + 1), 42),
            ]
        for r, nt, vol in seq:
            C(pat, b + r, 4, nt, 1, vol)
        C(pat, b, 5, N(name, octv - 1), 11, 36)
        if style in ("drive", "pulse"):
            C(pat, b + 8, 5, N(name, octv - 1), 11, 28)

def pad(pat, chords, vol=26, octv=4, ch=7):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        root, third, fifth = tones
        C(pat, b, ch, N(root, octv), 3, vol)
        C(pat, b + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)
        C(pat, b + 8, ch, N(fifth, octv), 3, vol + 2)
        C(pat, b + 10, ch, eff=4, param=0x34)

def organ(pat, chords, ch=9, vol=24, octv=4, rhythm=(2, 6, 10, 14)):
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        for i, h in enumerate(rhythm):
            tone = tones[i % 3]
            oc = octv + (1 if i == 3 else 0)
            C(pat, b + h, ch, N(tone, oc), 6, vol if i % 2 == 0 else vol - 4)

def arp(pat, chords, ch=6, inst=5, vol=26, octb=5, shape="up", every=2):
    shapes = {
        "up": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[2], 1),
        ],
        "down": lambda t: [
            (t[2], 1), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 0),
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 0),
        ],
        "bounce": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 0), (t[2], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[0], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[1], 1), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 0),
        ],
        "hook": lambda t: [
            (t[0], 1), (t[2], 0), (t[0], 0), (t[1], 1),
            (t[2], 0), (t[0], 1), (t[1], 0), (t[2], 1),
        ],
    }
    fn = shapes[shape]
    for bar, tones in enumerate(chords):
        b = bar * 16
        order = fn(tones)
        rows = list(range(0, 16, every))
        for i, r in enumerate(rows):
            nm, oc = order[i % len(order)]
            accent = 4 if r % 8 == 0 else (1 if r % 4 == 0 else 0)
            C(pat, b + r, ch, N(nm, octb + oc), inst, vol + accent)

def melody(pat, notes, ch=8, inst=2, vib=True):
    for i, (row, nt, vol) in enumerate(notes):
        C(pat, row, ch, nt, inst, vol)
        if not vib:
            continue
        nxt = notes[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(notes) else 64
        if nxt - row >= 4 and row + 2 < nxt and row + 2 <= 63:
            C(pat, row + 2, ch, eff=4, param=0x37)

def echo(pat, notes, ch=10, delay=3, drop=18, floor=14, inst=4):
    used = set()
    for row, nt, vol in notes:
        r = row + delay
        if r > 62 or r in used:
            continue
        v = vol - drop
        if v >= floor:
            C(pat, r, ch, nt, inst, v)
            used.add(r)

def doubles(pat, notes, ch=10, inst=2, every=8, drop=16, oct_shift=-1):
    for row, nt, vol in notes:
        if row % every == 0 and row < 62:
            C(pat, row, ch, shift_oct(nt, oct_shift), inst, max(16, vol - drop))

"""8-bit samples, authored at 8363 Hz so C-4 == middle C in this player.
Quieter low end, brighter lead/hat, more harmonic life in looping tones.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import wave

SR = 8363.0
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(77)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")

def write(name, x, peak=0.92):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x - np.mean(x)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * peak, -1, 1)
    pcm = np.clip(np.round((x + 1.0) * 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    path = out / f"{name}.wav"
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(1)
        w.setframerate(int(SR))
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    return len(pcm)

def n_cycles(cycles, f0=C4):
    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return max(16, n), cycles * SR / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty(len(x))
    acc = 0.0
    for i, v in enumerate(np.asarray(x, float)):
        acc = a * acc + (1 - a) * v
        y[i] = acc
    return y

def make_bass():
    # thinner, more mid-honk so it cuts without a sub wall
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.28
    for k in range(1, 14):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        # roll the fundamental, keep 2nd-5th
        if k == 1:
            a *= 0.55
        a *= np.exp(-0.09 * max(0, k - 4))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y += 0.10 * bloom * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * 3 * t)
    return y

def make_sub():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(2)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    return np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t)

def make_pulse():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    def pulse(duty, nh=18):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1, nh):
            a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
            a *= 0.94 ** max(0, k - 6)
            z += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
        return z
    mix = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)  # returns to start
    y = pulse(0.12) * (1 - mix) + pulse(0.28) * mix
    y *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph)
    return y

def make_saw():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 16):
        y += (1.0 / k) * (0.93 ** (k - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y2 = 0.16 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.10 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * f0 * t + 0.4)
    return y * 0.85 + bloom * y2

def make_pad():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(240)  # ~0.92 s
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    la = 0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    lb = 0.40 + 0.60 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph + 0.5)
    lc = 0.65 + 0.35 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * ph + 1.4)
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, amp, lfo, p0 in (
        (1, 0.34, la, 0.0),
        (2, 0.36, lb, 0.4),
        (3, 0.28, lc, 1.1),
        (4, 0.16, la, 0.2),
        (5, 0.10, lb, 1.8),
        (6, 0.06, lc, 0.6),
        (7, 0.04, la, 2.0),
    ):
        y += amp * lfo * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

def make_organ():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, a, p0 in ((1, 0.40, 0), (2, 0.36, 0.2), (3, 0.30, 0.6),
                     (4, 0.16, 1.0), (5, 0.08, 0.3), (6, 0.06, 1.4)):
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

def make_pluck(dur, bright, noise_amt, nh=14):
    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, nh):
        decay = 0.045 + 0.22 / (k ** 0.4)
        amp = (bright ** (k - 1))
        y += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * np.exp(-t / decay)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.5)
    y += noise_amt * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.007)
    y[:3] *= np.linspace(0.2, 1, 3)
    y[-6:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 6)
    return y

def make_bell():
    n = int(0.70 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.01 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.12)
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * t + 2.6 * mod) * np.exp(-t / 0.38)
    y += 0.40 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.76 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.20)
    y += 0.22 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 5.40 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    y += 0.10 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 8.1 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.05)
    y[-20:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 20)
    return y

def make_kick():
    n = int(0.16 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = 62 + 200 * np.exp(-t / 0.016)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    body = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)  # shorter body, less sub smear
    click = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1800 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.0025)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    y = 0.85 * body + 0.45 * click + 0.18 * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.003)
    y = np.tanh(y * 1.4)
    y[-4:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 4)
    return y

def make_snare():
    n = int(0.12 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    high = nz - lp1(nz, 0.12)
    mid = lp1(nz, 0.35) - lp1(nz, 0.7)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 210 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.028)
    y = 0.62 * high * np.exp(-t / 0.035) + 0.22 * mid * np.exp(-t / 0.05)
    y += 0.32 * tone
    y = np.tanh(1.2 * y)
    return y

def make_hat(dur, decay, bright=1.0):
    n = max(16, int(dur * SR))
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    # square-ish metallic noise, plenty of highs
    freqs = [480, 730, 990, 1370, 1780, 2290, 2870, 3520, 4010]
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
        y += (0.4 / (1 + 0.18 * i)) * np.sign(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 3)))
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    # highpass-ish
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.08)
    y = 0.35 * y + 0.75 * nz * bright
    y *= np.exp(-t / decay)
    return y

def make_tom(fstart=180):
    n = int(0.14 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = fstart * 0.7 + fstart * 0.55 * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    y = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)
    y += 0.2 * np.sin(2 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.02)
    return y

def make_stab():
    n = int(0.16 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 12):
        y += (0.7 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t) * np.exp(-t / (0.03 + 0.05 / k))
    return y

lengths = {
    "bass": write("bass", make_bass(), 0.88),
    "sub": write("sub", make_sub(), 0.80),
    "pulse": write("pulse", make_pulse(), 0.95),
    "saw": write("saw", make_saw(), 0.95),
    "pad": write("pad", make_pad(), 0.85),
    "organ": write("organ", make_organ(), 0.90),
    "pluck": write("pluck", make_pluck(0.36, 0.72, 0.35), 0.95),
    "arp": write("arp", make_pluck(0.16, 0.88, 0.18, nh=16), 0.95),
    "bell": write("bell", make_bell(), 0.95),
    "kick": write("kick", make_kick(), 0.98),
    "snare": write("snare", make_snare(), 0.95),
    "hat": write("hat", make_hat(0.026, 0.007, 1.2), 0.90),
    "ohat": write("ohat", make_hat(0.08, 0.026, 1.0), 0.88),
    "tom": write("tom", make_tom(), 0.92),
    "stab": write("stab", make_stab(), 0.92),
}
json.dump(lengths, open("/tmp/samples/lengths.json", "w"), indent=0)
print(lengths)
PY"}

SR = 8363.0
C4 = 261.6255653006
rng = np.random.default_rng(77)
out = Path("/tmp/samples")

def write(name, x, peak=0.92):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    x = x - np.mean(x)
    m = np.max(np.abs(x)) or 1.0
    x = np.clip(x / m * peak, -1, 1)
    pcm = np.clip(np.round((x + 1.0) * 127.5), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
    path = out / f"{name}.wav"
    with wave.open(str(path), "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(1)
        w.setframerate(int(SR))
        w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes())
    return len(pcm)

def n_cycles(cycles, f0=C4):
    n = int(round(cycles * SR / f0))
    return max(16, n), cycles * SR / n

def lp1(x, a):
    y = np.empty(len(x))
    acc = 0.0
    for i, v in enumerate(np.asarray(x, float)):
        acc = a * acc + (1 - a) * v
        y[i] = acc
    return y

def make_bass():
    # thinner, more mid-honk so it cuts without a sub wall
    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    duty = 0.28
    for k in range(1, 14):
        a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
        # roll the fundamental, keep 2nd-5th
        if k == 1:
            a *= 0.55
        a *= np.exp(-0.09 * max(0, k - 4))
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y += 0.10 * bloom * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * 3 * t)
    return y

def make_sub():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(2)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    return np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * t)

def make_pulse():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    def pulse(duty, nh=18):
        z = np.zeros(n)
        for k in range(1, nh):
            a = 2 * np.sin(k * np.pi * duty) / (k * np.pi)
            a *= 0.94 ** max(0, k - 6)
            z += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
        return z
    mix = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)  # returns to start
    y = pulse(0.12) * (1 - mix) + pulse(0.28) * mix
    y *= 0.92 + 0.08 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph)
    return y

def make_saw():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(8)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 16):
        y += (1.0 / k) * (0.93 ** (k - 1)) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t)
    bloom = 0.5 - 0.5 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * ph)
    y2 = 0.16 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * f0 * t) + 0.10 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * f0 * t + 0.4)
    return y * 0.85 + bloom * y2

def make_pad():
    n, f0 = n_cycles(240)  # ~0.92 s
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    ph = np.arange(n) / n
    la = 0.55 + 0.45 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * ph)
    lb = 0.40 + 0.60 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * ph + 0.5)
    lc = 0.65 + 0.35 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * ph + 1.4)
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, amp, lfo, p0 in (
        (1, 0.34, la, 0.0),
        (2, 0.36, lb, 0.4),
        (3, 0.28, lc, 1.1),
        (4, 0.16, la, 0.2),
        (5, 0.10, lb, 1.8),
        (6, 0.06, lc, 0.6),
        (7, 0.04, la, 2.0),
    ):
        y += amp * lfo * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

    n, f0 = n_cycles(4)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k, a, p0 in ((1, 0.40, 0), (2, 0.36, 0.2), (3, 0.30, 0.6),
                     (4, 0.16, 1.0), (5, 0.08, 0.3), (6, 0.06, 1.4)):
        y += a * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f0 * k * t + p0)
    return y

    n = int(dur * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, nh):
        decay = 0.045 + 0.22 / (k ** 0.4)
        amp = (bright ** (k - 1))
        y += amp * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t + rng.uniform(0, 6)) * np.exp(-t / decay)

    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.5)
    y += noise_amt * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.007)
    y[:3] *= np.linspace(0.2, 1, 3)
    y[-6:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 6)
    return y

    n = int(0.70 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    mod = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.01 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.12)
    y = np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * t + 2.6 * mod) * np.exp(-t / 0.38)
    y += 0.40 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 2.76 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.20)
    y += 0.22 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 5.40 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.09)
    y += 0.10 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * 8.1 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.05)
    y[-20:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 20)
    return y

def make_kick():
    n = int(0.16 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = 62 + 200 * np.exp(-t / 0.016)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    body = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)  # shorter body, less sub smear
    click = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1800 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.0025)
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    y = 0.85 * body + 0.45 * click + 0.18 * nz * np.exp(-t / 0.003)
    y = np.tanh(y * 1.4)
    y[-4:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, 4)
    return y

def make_snare():
    n = int(0.12 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    high = nz - lp1(nz, 0.12)
    mid = lp1(nz, 0.35) - lp1(nz, 0.7)
    tone = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 210 * t) * np.exp(-t / 0.028)
    y = 0.62 * high * np.exp(-t / 0.035) + 0.22 * mid * np.exp(-t / 0.05)
    y += 0.32 * tone
    y = np.tanh(1.2 * y)
    return y

def make_hat(dur, decay, bright=1.0):
    n = max(16, int(dur * SR))
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    # square-ish metallic noise, plenty of highs
    freqs = [480, 730, 990, 1370, 1780, 2290, 2870, 3520, 4010]
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for i, f in enumerate(freqs):
        y += (0.4 / (1 + 0.18 * i)) * np.sign(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t + rng.uniform(0, 3)))
    nz = rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    # highpass-ish
    nz = nz - lp1(nz, 0.08)
    y = 0.35 * y + 0.75 * nz * bright
    y *= np.exp(-t / decay)
    return y

def make_tom(fstart=180):
    n = int(0.14 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    f = fstart * 0.7 + fstart * 0.55 * np.exp(-t / 0.03)
    phase = 2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(f) / SR
    y = np.sin(phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.055)
    y += 0.2 * np.sin(2 * phase) * np.exp(-t / 0.02)
    return y

def make_stab():
    n = int(0.16 * SR)
    t = np.arange(n) / SR
    y = np.zeros(n)
    for k in range(1, 12):
        y += (0.7 / k) * np.sin(2 * np.pi * C4 * k * t) * np.exp(-t / (0.03 + 0.05 / k))
    return y

lengths = {
    "bass": write("bass", make_bass(), 0.88),
    "sub": write("sub", make_sub(), 0.80),
    "pulse": write("pulse", make_pulse(), 0.95),
    "saw": write("saw", make_saw(), 0.95),
    "pad": write("pad", make_pad(), 0.85),
    "organ": write("organ", make_organ(), 0.90),
    "pluck": write("pluck", make_pluck(0.36, 0.72, 0.35), 0.95),
    "arp": write("arp", make_pluck(0.16, 0.88, 0.18, nh=16), 0.95),
    "bell": write("bell", make_bell(), 0.95),
    "kick": write("kick", make_kick(), 0.98),
    "snare": write("snare", make_snare(), 0.95),
    "hat": write("hat", make_hat(0.026, 0.007, 1.2), 0.90),
    "ohat": write("ohat", make_hat(0.08, 0.026, 1.0), 0.88),
    "tom": write("tom", make_tom(), 0.92),
    "stab": write("stab", make_stab(), 0.92),
}
json.dump(lengths, open("/tmp/samples/lengths.json", "w"), indent=0)
print(lengths)

song=8*64*6*(2.5/146)
one=int(song*sr)

def bands(seg):
    S=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))**2
    f=np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/sr)
    edges=[100,250,600,1500,3000,6000,12000]
    tot=S.sum()+1
    prev=30; parts=[]
    for e in edges:
        parts.append(S[(f>=prev)&(f<e)].sum()/tot); prev=e
    parts.append(S[f>=prev].sum()/tot)
    return parts

print("section  rms  width  bands(100 250 600 1.5k 3k 6k 12k +)")

print("peak", np.max(np.abs(L)), np.max(np.abs(R)), "rmsL", round(np.sqrt(np.mean(L**2))), "rmsR", round(np.sqrt(np.mean(R**2))))
print("width", round(np.mean(np.abs(L-R))/(np.mean(np.abs(L+R))+1), 3), "corr", round(float(np.corrcoef(L[::10],R[::10])[0,1]),3))
print("clip", float(np.mean(np.max(np.abs(x),1)>32000)))
print("tail rms 80ms", round(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[-int(0.08*sr):]**2))), "head 80ms", round(np.sqrt(np.mean(mono[:int(0.08*sr)]**2))))
# theoretical crossfade click: difference if we concat
# can't hear loop from one pass. measure last sample vs first
print("edge jump if concatenated", abs(mono[-1]-mono[0]), "typical step", np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(mono[sr:sr+2000]))))
